summary: Shared change (client UI flow). Table clicks, phase 7 (piles). Cards in a discard or dead pile can be the target, candidate, performer or source of an action: the pile on the table is tinted while it holds such a card, opening it (or the Dead-cards gallery) marks those cards, and a click closes the pile and selects the card as a click on a card in play would. An action played from the discard pile (Scandalous Gossip, Discipline) starts from its card in the pile. Client only.
validation: Native: check-table-click-ui passes with two new steps (A Yojimbo's Duty recruits a discarded Agasha Kodo chosen from the Dynasty discard pile after the pile is tinted and the target marked; Scandalous Gossip starts from the Fate discard pile and its player is then chosen by clicking a stronghold); check-fallen, check-board-ui, check-direct-play-ui, check-multi-targets-ui, check-interactions, check-reaction-flow-ui, check-decision-chooser, check-stabilization, check-province-target-ui pass. The Dead-cards gallery rows use the same actionable test and a new Chosen event but have no dedicated native step. Previously noted failures unchanged. Native UI checks are not run in CI.
remaining: Phases 8 to 10 of the table-click plan. Removed-from-game cards are not shown in a pile on the table and are not covered.
